What's your return and refund policy?
You can start any return or exchange here: https://nakedwardrobe.com/apps/aftership-returns-center
RETURN & REFUND POLICY:
- RETURN WINDOW: within 14 DAYS AFTER DELIVERY.
- CONDITION: item must be in ORIGINAL CONDITION, UNWORN/UNUSED, with TAGS ATTACHED, ORIGINAL PACKAGING, and PROOF OF PURCHASE.
- STORE CREDIT ONLY: items returned with MAKEUP, SELF-TANNER, DEODORANT, PET HAIR, OR STAINS, and FINAL-SALE ITEMS.
- RESTOCKING FEE: $9.99 is deducted from each refund.
- NON-RETURNABLE ITEMS: INTERNATIONAL ORDERS (EXCEPT CANADA), INTIMATES, BODYSUITS, JEWELRY, ALL MARKDOWN OR SALE ITEMS, and GIFT CARDS.
- REFUND TIMING: after we receive and inspect the return, refunds are issued to the ORIGINAL PAYMENT METHOD WITHIN 10 BUSINESS DAYS, plus any bank processing time.
- If it’s been MORE THAN 14 BUSINESS DAYS SINCE YOUR RETURN WAS RECEIVED, please contact NW@NAKEDWARDROBE.COM.
- STORE CREDIT: issued as a NAKED WARDROBE GIFT CARD to the email on the original order once the return is reviewed.
If you want to do a SIZE OR COLOR EXCHANGE, use the same portal, select “ITEM DID NOT FIT,” then choose “REPLACE WITH SAME ITEM.”
